other_failure_modes.name: Non-deterministic categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Using an unordered collection like `set` to establish categorical levels leads to non-deterministic category ordering across Python runs due to hash randomization. This causes tree-based algorithms to receive different integer encodings for the same categories across runs, breaking reproducibility.

summary: The agent implements a generally reasonable regression pipeline with native categorical handling for tree models and an inverse-RMSE weighted ensemble. However, there are notable data leakage issues: median imputation is performed before the validation split (leaking validation statistics into the training loop), and test data is peeked at to construct the categorical superset. Additionally, using `set` for category union introduces non-determinism, and the solution lacks any substantive feature engineering.
